proven.rust_unit_wrapper_exact_head: Railway deployment 09da96e1-f989-43d4-9e5e-3001b5e36335 succeeded and contract suite includes cargo test --locked -p core-kernel --lib

blockers: Rust VNext matrix contradicts final DOC-C event/actor/transition authority.
Tier 5 is incorrectly rejected and runtime depth enforcement contradicts build-time-only law.
Strict no-wrap/no-saturating law is not met; allocator uses wrapping address arithmetic.
no_global_alloc feature permits system allocator fallback for std consumers.
Daemon writes raw ShadowWal payloads instead of enforcing canonical DurableWal<WalRecord> for all authoritative mutations.
ShadowWal sequence resets to zero on restart while appending to existing WAL.
Boot hashes WAL file bytes instead of reconstructing canonical state from snapshot+records.
Unreadable/empty/missing WAL collapse to None and are treated as clean start.
Existing WAL without anchor is accepted as clean start.
Binary hash failure warns and continues.
Attestation/binary/WAL anchors are mutable local /tmp files; attestation is TOFU rather than TPM/HSM remote attestation.
Anchor write failure can still be followed by success-looking 'updated' log output.
Production partial-WAL recovery, durable snapshot backend, crash-loop SAFE MODE and Layer-11 hardware/storage enforcement are incomplete or missing.
L1o memory law is incomplete: no immutable VerifiedMemory or decaying ExperimentalMemory; WorkingMemory allows overwrite/silent drop.
notes: GitHub Actions runs 36693582979 and 36693583122 fail before steps execute (empty runner/steps); do not classify as code-test failures.
Daemon O_DIRECT log text is stale/misleading: ShadowWal implementation uses O_DSYNC and not O_DIRECT, which matches the storage law.
Do not derive a global project completion percentage from this core-kernel-specific matrix.
